scope: Focused Wave32 workforce-point engine and UI regression evidence on the working candidate

engineCases: W32-P01: the six specialist profiles and displayed labels match the authored point contract
W32-P02: readiness and saved employee fractions scale every profile component exactly
W32-P03: the founder still shares twenty points and cannot create Hardware output
W32-P04: workforce totals include owned secondary output and exclude foreign employees
W32-P05: paid onboarding, assignment changes and dismissal affect actual weekly output at their boundaries
W32-P06: actual preparation gains thirty specialist points versus twenty founder points and does not bank idle output
W32-P07: a researcher’s secondary Data points advance the real preparation job
W32-P08: real research consumes specialist points independently of its compute meter and following-week unlock
W32-P09: specialist Design points increase actual training supervision once while GPUs remain an independent limit
W32-P10: simultaneous requests share each specialty budget without cross-role borrowing or double grants
W32-P11: an owner that grants the same specialist output twice rolls back the entire week
W32-P12: point-based planning previews stay pure and match the actual changed output after one boundary
W32-P13: authentic 0.28 progress and queued assignments migrate without changing any saved economic field
W32-P14: save/reload preserves future point grants and progress without replaying work or recruitment
W32-P15: a real mature company preserves paid history and continues deterministically with the new matrix
W32-P16: the first point-version save archives exact 0.28 bytes and write failures preserve the old company
W32-P17: two paid Design specialists can meet foundation Research admission through secondary output
uiCases: W32-U01: every hire card displays its actual specialty and two secondary weekly outputs
W32-U02: founder point choices preserve saved fractions and the shared twenty-point limit
W32-U03: real paid onboarding displays zero current output until the actual ready week
W32-U04: fractional current and proposed employee output remain distinct without changing payroll
W32-U05: assignment review projects next week without falsely showing an onboarding employee as ready now
W32-U06: selecting an older employee keeps that person’s point profile and one review summary
W32-U07: invalid founder and employee output stays blocked without inventing a valid point preview
W32-U08: observers can read employee output but cannot submit a point change or hire
W32-U09: the team table adds secondary output to the founder and separates allocation from completed work

typecheck.observation: Completed after both new test files were present; no production or test type errors.

limits: This is targeted regression coverage, not a full economy or every-feature campaign run.
Prior Wave31B counts and old/new future parity remain the pre-mechanics baseline; they are not counted as current Wave32 verification.
Affected existing engine regressions are owned and reported separately by source_review.
Browser interaction, screenshots, final restore, production build and publication are owned and reported separately by the root agent.
Only repository-owned test fixtures are referenced; this record contains no private save payloads.
